messages:
ivy: heads-up: hitting a weird one in the electron quickstart. When running in dev (electron --inspect) the renderer console logs sometimes show the raw request-id before our redaction runs.

devon: can you paste a tiny repro and logs?

ivy: repro: clone github.com/redwood/sample-apps/electron-telemetry, yarn && yarn start:dev, trigger a login from renderer. Console shows: 
```
Renderer (debug): auth.fetch - headers: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc123 reqid=tmp-999
Main (info): session: created reqid=REDACTED
```
Looks like the preload script's fetch wrapper logs headers at debug level before our main-process redaction hook runs.

hao: interesting. Is the SDK init happening in main or preload?

ivy: we init telemetry in main process on app ready, but the preload script is loaded earlier and requires a tiny shared lib that polyfills fetch and logs (for convenience). That module imports the SDK and triggers debug logs at require-time.

devon: so ordering and cross-process imports — preload runs before main's app ready. Two options: move SDK init into a tiny preload-safe module that registers a no-op redaction filter synchronously, or change the fetch polyfill to avoid logging sensitive headers.

hao: we should do both. For quickstart: avoid logging headers in preload and call a synchronous telemetry.attach_preload_guard() that ensures redaction applied to any logs emitted from preload. For SDK: expose attach_for_renderer_process() that safely attaches filters to console.* and any electron-logger libs.

ivy: agreed. I hacked a local fix: remove header logging from preload and add a tiny sync guard that monkeypatches console.debug to run messages through redactRegex before printing. That fixed the repro.

devon: nice. Can you open a PR to update the quickstart and add a short note in onboarding: "For Electron quickstart, initialize telemetry in main early and avoid logging sensitive headers from preload scripts. Use SDK helper for preload-safe redaction." 

telemetry-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/2345 - "Electron quickstart: preload scripts can log raw reqids/credentials in dev; add preload guard and doc note" Labels: devex, telemetry, bug.

hao: follow-up: audit other renderer frameworks (NW.js, Tauri) for similar preload/bridge ordering problems. Also consider a default small regex-based console wrapper in the SDK that is safe to install early, opt-out via env var for advanced users. Might prevent a lot of quickstart pain.

ivy: I'll add PR with minimal change: remove header debug in preload, add example in README and small unit test that spawns electron in dev mode and asserts console output doesn't contain unredacted tokens. Will link to issue.

devon: thanks. If we add SDK console wrapper be careful about performance and false positives. Make it opt-in and documented.

ivy: will do. ping here when PR is up. Thanks :thumbsup:
